comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This historical event of the 15th Century (2nd period) is one of the few adventure-type events. To participate, you have to register for the ship race and sail from Lisbon to The Azores.... in a light/small-class ship. About 20 times.

Yep. Have fun with that one. Noteworthy rewards for racing enough times:

Wanderer of the Ages Hat / Pioneer of History - (unlocked at the same time; title must be picked up from a certain NPC)
Traveler's Treasure Box - final reward

Cheers.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?WorldClock/Arrival at the Azores Islands

I guess the game couldn't handle having two going on at the same time, so that's why it bugged out. You get the usual race participation tickets and then at various increments also:

3xHeadache Medication

wiki:
Event Type: Ship Race (light/small class ships only)
Route: Lisbon to The Azores

Details: Talk to any port official/guide in Lisbon, click Race Information button, choose Join option (1,000 ducats to register) and set sail when you are ready. The timer begins at sea and ends when you speak to The Azores port official.

Each completed trip counts as progress for your nation in the historical event and can unlock rewards (sent to bank; use Receive Item button to retrieve them when ready). You do not have to be in the top 10 to receive the rewards listed below.

NOTE: If any member of your fleet is in a non-small/light class ship, or if you swap from a small/light class ship to a different type of ship, your participation in the race will automatically be canceled. No fair cheating!

Rewards:

1 trip - Headache Medication x3
? trips - Silver Tarot x3
? trips - Change Expedition Destination Ticket x3
? trips - Shipwreck Map Piece x3
? trips - Improved Gallant Staysail
? trips - Wanderer of the Ages Hat + Pioneer of History Title (if not yet unlocked)
? trips - Traveler's Treasure Box
